source_description_html:
Description

  • Including: 2pcs brake disc.
  • Fit for Suzuki GSX S 1000 / GSX S 1000F 2015-2018.
  • Ultra hardened 420 (2Cr13) stainless steel & 6061-T6 aluminum disc, heat treated for warp resistance.
  • Wave shape brake disc rotor 20% light weight than OEM.
  • Wavy & slotted design disc to help keep pads clean and provide best heat dissipation performance.
  • The vented slots ensure water and dirt are dispersed quickly when braking & speed up air circulation to improve heat dissipation.
  • Surfaces are electro-statically coated to ensure a long term appearance.
  • Please replace your rotor when it reaches the minimum thickness we marked on the surface to ensure your safety.

Outer diameter 310mm
Inner diameter 110.5mm
Thickness 5mm
Hole quantity 6
Hole size 8.5mm
Hole spacing 132mm
